chunks: Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Ri'ab, from Abu Ubeyda Al-Hazza', from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
It is an obligation for the believer upon the believer, [to give] sincere advice.
ai.seo_question: What is the religious obligation of a believer towards another believer regarding advice?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elevates nasihah from a mere social courtesy to a binding religious duty (wajib), underscoring the spiritual interconnectedness of the community. In Shia jurisprudence, this establishes the framework for mutual accountability, where believers are obligated to guide one another toward righteousness and away from error, reflecting the broader concept of 'Amr bil Ma'ruf'.
